sourceRelation: 640f201e and 9f49f1f4 have identical recorder source; their only tree difference is changeset text. original-interval-experiment.patch is git diff 640f201e..3d99e2dc and passes git apply --check at 9f49f1f4.
viewer: Harness starts serve-sim; no browser viewer is opened by the script.
runOrder: Pass 1: record-sim, 120,60,30,15. Pass 2: 15,30,60,120,record-sim. Each pass runs still,navigate,scroll in that order.
scenarioDuration: 60 seconds of input/idle, plus recorder startup/stop. Container duration is read from each actual MP4.
recordSimSource: Built from expo/eas-cli packages/build-tools/resources/record-sim. Original exact source commit was not saved; contextual comparison is not a paired before/after change for PR243.
rawExport: Packet timestamps, sizes, flags, and non-sensitive stream/container fields freshly extracted from retained original MP4s by ffprobe 8.1.2. No new recording was made.
originalResults: original-size-results.json is the byte-for-byte retained scen/scen-results.json used for the published chart. analyze.py --verify confirms all 30 per-run size/keyframe metrics match those original measurements.
limits: Two runs per cell, descriptive measurements, not confidence bounds.
No browser seek latency was measured. Keyframes reduce prerequisite decode work; they do not quantize browser seeks.
Source pauses can cause keyframe timestamp gaps longer than a second; resumed-picture behavior is tested separately.
Presentation timestamp backsteps in decode packet order may be expected with B-frames, and are not proof of visible frame disorder.
Frame count and presentation gaps do not prove unique pictures or no stream impact.
The first record-sim still file has container duration 116.715 seconds; the second 62.885. Both retained, not silently excluded.
replicationHarness: scenario.sh/matrix.sh/drag.mjs preserve scenarios and limits while accepting public paths/device parameters and isolating state. They add readiness failure, input-admission wait, and cleanup. Syntax checks passed; the newly portable device harness has not been re-run on a Simulator.
